main_text.p: magni inter cæteras momenti, quæ juxta AlMotar-rezium, toti huic cultui nomen dederit, quæ fit inclinato capite & sublatis inferioribus corporis partibus, eam asserit Maimonides Idololatriæ antiquæ, & turpissimi cultus obscæno terriculo BaalPeor olim delati, vestigium esse non Maimon. in ep. ad proselyt. relig.obscurum באמת שהיוד [?] לישמעאלים מקורם באותם המקומות שלשה מיני עבורה זרה פעור ומרקליס [?] וכמוש והם עצמם מורים ברבים אלו וקוראים להם שמות בלשון ערבי פעור עבורתו שיפעיר עצמו לפניו או שיניח ראשו וינביר ערותולמולו כמו שאלו הישמעאלים משתחוים היום בתפלתם Certum est fuisse Ismaelitis olim istâ in locis tres cultus Idololatrici species, scil. Peor, Mercu-rium & Cemosh, quæ ipsi jam confitentur, & nomini-bus in linguâ Arabicâ [notis] appellant. Peoris autem cultus ita peragebatur ut qui se coram ipso nudaret, aut capite demisso obscœnas corporis partes attolleret, quo modo Ismaelitæ ipsi se, his etiam temporibus, inter orandum incurvant. Quæ de aliis cultus Idololatrici vestigiis sequuntur, apponendi mox erit occasio.

3 Eleemosyna فان اللــه جعل الزكوة احسن [?] مبادي الاسلام (inquit AlGazalius) Constituit Deus eleemosynam, unum è fundamentis Islamismi, de eo præceptum in Alcorano, inter prima. scil. c. 2do اقيموا الصلاة واتوا الزكاة Orationes constanter peragite & Eleemosynam præstate; dicitur que liber iste datus in directionem iis qui rite preces fundunt & eleemosynas largiuntur. Eleemosynis autem nomen hoc, apud Arabes impositum volunt, vel â زكي quod crescere & superi significat, quòd inde accessurum omnibus incrementum speretur, ut in explicatione Ritualis,

page.notes: Printed text is copied as far as legible. The Hebrew lines are set inline within the Latin paragraph and are transcribed letter by letter; the words marked [?] and the Hebrew word-divisions are uncertain at this scan resolution. The Arabic lines are approximate in their word forms and diacritics; [?] marks the doubtful word. "AlMotar-rezium" assumes a printed hyphen at the line break. "dicitur que" is printed with a space and is left as seen. The margin note is the single left-margin reference "Maimon. in ep. ad proselyt. relig.". The Google watermark at bottom right is not transcribed.
